title: Load and Value Rates for Home Delivery of Deposit-Program Ridgeline Special Order Services Orders
content:
The home delivery charge on a delivered Ridgeline Special Order Services order in a program whose deposit at order is 50 percent starts from a load charge set by the order total billed on the order.

**Clause.** A billed total of at least 3 times the program's order minimum is charged the greater of the program's home delivery fee and 3.5 percent of the billed total, that percentage rounded to the cent; a billed total below 1.5 times the order minimum is charged the program's home delivery fee less 30.00; any other billed total is charged the program's home delivery fee.

The load charge is the starting amount of the delivery charge billed on the order.

## Terms used

- **The billed total** is the order total billed on the order, read from its order billing line.
- The program's order minimum and home delivery fee are the figures of the order's program.

## Marks for the deposit programs

| Program | Order minimum | 3 times the minimum | 1.5 times the minimum | Home delivery fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Special Order Windows and Exterior Doors | 300.00 | 900.00 | 450.00 | 99.00 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Semi-Custom Cabinetry | 1500.00 | 4500.00 | 2250.00 | 149.00 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Fabricated Countertops | 800.00 | 2400.00 | 1200.00 | 0.00 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical orders)

| Program and billed total | Band | Load charge |
|---|---|---|
| Windows and Exterior Doors, 4200.00 | at least 900.00; 3.5 percent is 147.00, above 99.00 | 147.00 |
| Windows and Exterior Doors, 1000.00 | at least 900.00; 3.5 percent is 35.00, below 99.00 | 99.00 |
| Windows and Exterior Doors, 900.00 | at least 900.00; 3.5 percent is 31.50 | 99.00 |
| Windows and Exterior Doors, 600.00 | between the marks | 99.00 |
| Windows and Exterior Doors, 449.00 | below 450.00 | 99.00 less 30.00: 69.00 |
| Semi-Custom Cabinetry, 8000.00 | at least 4500.00; 3.5 percent is 280.00 | 280.00 |
| Semi-Custom Cabinetry, 2000.00 | below 2250.00 | 119.00 |
